parsed_json.up: Identify compounds with exact IC50 measurements against both CHEMBL203 and CHEMBL1824. Filter for rows where standard_relation is '=' and standard_units is 'nM'. Compute the minimum IC50 per compound for each target. Keep compounds with minimum IC50 < 50 nM against CHEMBL203 and minimum IC50 > 200 nM against CHEMBL1824. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for matching compounds. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
